Novartis AG Plunged After Two Failures
: Novartis (NOVN) plunged after two late-stage trial failures: an experimental cholesterol drug and a muscle-wasting therapy. Stock fell ~3.4% then intraday up to 10.9%, record one-day drop.
Novartis NOVN Shares Drop On Failures

: Novartis (NOVN) saw ~10% share drop after late-stage failure of neuromuscular candidate del-desiran; del-brax also out. Company kept 2025–30 sales guidance; analysts see weaker 2030s growth outlook.
: Novartis (NOVN): FDA granted priority review for delpacibart zotadirsen (exon 44 Duchenne). Company to meet FDA on delpacibart braxlosiran after positive Phase I/II biomarker results in FSHD.
Deutsche Bank Downgrades Novartis To Hold
: Deutsche Bank downgraded Novartis AG (NOVN) to Hold and cut its price target, citing patent expirations in the early 2030s and recent clinical trial setbacks affecting future sales.
: Novartis (NOVN) keeps guidance unchanged, cites broad pipeline and disciplined capital allocation. Investors criticized the 2024 MorphoSys acquisition markdown and urged board and pay changes.
